bug_semantics: UAParser.js 2.0.1–2.0.9 ReDoS in withClientHints(): HTTP Client Hints copy Sec-CH-UA-Model via stripQuotes() with no UA_MAX_LENGTH (unlike User-Agent, capped at 500). parseCH() then builds the synthetic string 'droid 9; ' + model + ')' and runs the full device regex map, including / ([\w ]+) miui\/v?\d/i. The nested [\w ]+ plus a following space causes polynomial backtracking on long space-separated tokens (PoC: 'A '.repeat(25000) with Android/mobile hints). Availability-only; server-side UAParser(headers).withClientHints() is the attack path.
flaw_origin: The unbounded CH_MODEL copy and the MIUI regex already existed, but parseCH DEVICE only assigned uaCH[MODEL] and did not regex-parse it, so Client Hints could not reach the ReDoS engine. aed89f0b414fe75d843f983636d389bc1f94147e (Fix #660) first wrote rgxMapper.call(reParse, 'droid 9; ' + uaCH[MODEL] + ')', rgxMap) without truncating the model, completing the CVE mechanism. Same-day earlier fc851b40c5db6fe582f2bb017aec694b00b1f9f6 first wrote the MIUI pattern; 2.0.0 has neither and is outside the affected range.

reasoning: CVE-2026-48125 / GHSA-9h5v-pfqq-x599 is a published, non-withdrawn ReDoS: crafted Sec-CH-UA-Model is copied without UA_MAX_LENGTH and fed to device regexes in withClientHints(). 2.0.0 already had unbounded stripQuotes of CH_HEADER_MODEL and withClientHints(), but parseCH DEVICE did not run rgxMapper on the model, so 2.0.0 is correctly unaffected. The MIUI backtracking regex landed the same day in fc851b40, still only on length-capped User-Agent strings. The smallest commit that first wrote the CVE mechanism is aed89f0b, which introduced reParse of 'droid 9; ' + uaCH[MODEL] + ')' against the device map while the model stayed unbounded. Immediate parent 48c221b5 lacks 'droid 9' / reParse and was verified in-tree; aed89f0b is a single-parent first-write, not a move, revert, or squash. Subsequent 1d8eab09 only relocated those lines. The fix 90354d3 both caps CH values at 500 and tightens the MIUI regex, and is the first patched release 2.0.10.
